def: An open-source (BSD-2-Clause) Python framework, maintained by Daily and its community, for building real-time voice and multimodal agents from pipelines of transport, speech, model and synthesis services.
practice: Swappable provider services make it a common base for cascaded voice pipelines, its team maintains the open Smart Turn end-of-turn model, and the Voice AI and Voice Agents guide uses it for its code.
